    (COUNT(DISTINCT dpe.eq_id) * (7 * 24 * 3600)) AS availability_rate
FROM 
    downtime dpl
JOIN 
    equipment dpe ON dpl.eq_id = dpe.eq_id
JOIN 
    work_orders wow ON dpe.line_id = wow.line_id
JOIN 
    production_log dplg ON wow.wo_id = dplg.wo_id
WHERE 
    dpl.start_ts >= '2026-09-18 00:00:00' AND dpl.start_ts < '2026-09-25 23:59:59' 
    AND dpe.line_id = 'L4'
GROUP BY 
    dpe.line_id
